claim.summary: For every u>=2, a satisfiable binary Boolean system on5+10u variables has proper J2=C2 equal to its quadratic axiom span with no affine consequences. With five inputs x_i and full affine multiplier domain V1, the actual tuple image has c=10u+6; every nonzero coefficient row has contraction rank4u+5 and intersection dimension6u+1. Uniform mean intersection is(196u+37)/32>c/2; nonzero-row mean6u+1>(15/31)c. Thus a+L+delta<=D cannot generally replace a+L+2delta<=D in binary shortening. AtC3 all mixed x_i y_ab vanish by explicit degree3 certificates; same tuple image has dimension6 and nonzero-row rank5. Original linear source replay needs degree3 and the smaller generated domain from V0 only has dimension6, so this does not establish a useful source-level exception or hard-family obstruction.
claim.assessment: Working all-copy alternating-space quotient construction, medium reviewed. Exact GAP at u2 compares raw quotient and normal-form ranks for all32 rows and checks10 degree3 polynomial certificates. No numerical extrapolation; control is a genuine PC quotient but satisfiable.
